questions.question: A cube of side 125 cm is painted red on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 25 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes having at least two faces painted.
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

Length of the side of the big cube = 125 cm.

Length of the side of the smaller cube = 25 cm.

__**Formula:**__

A cube is a three-dimensional figure with 8 corners, 6 surfaces, and 12 edges (sides).

If a cube is painted on all of its surfaces with the same colour, and then divided into smaller cubes of equal size, then the number of smaller cubes so obtained will be calculated as follows:

__
 
• Number of cubes with no face painted = (n - 2)³
 
• Number of cubes with one face painted = 6(n - 2)²
 
• Number of cubes with two faces painted = 12(n - 2)
 
• Number of cubes with three faces painted = 8(Always)

 where n = No. of parts of each side = Length of the side of larger cube ÷ length of the side of the smaller cube

**Calculation:__**

n = 125 ÷ 25 = 5

⇒ n - 2 = 3

Number of smaller cubes having at least two faces painted

= total no. of cubes - (no. of cubes with no face painted + no. of cubes with only one face painted)

= 125 - (3³ + 6 × 3²)

= 125 - (27 + 54)

= 125 - 81

= 44

Hence, 44 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Avanish got 78% marks in an examination and Kapil got 64% marks in the same examination. If the sum of the marks obtained by Kapil and Avanish is 923, then find the marks obtained by Kapil in the examination.
questions.solution:
• Avanish got 78% marks in an examination and Kapil got 64% marks in the same examination. 

Let the exam be of 'x' marks.

 
• The sum of the marks obtained by Kapil and Avanish is 923.

According to question:

78% of x + 64% of x = 923

⇒ 78/100 × x + 64/100 × x = 923

⇒ (78x + 64x) / 100 = 923

⇒ 142x = 923 × 100

⇒ x = 92300 ÷ 142

⇒ x = 650

The marks obtained by Kapil in the examination = 64% of x 

= 64% of 650

= 64/100 × 650

= 416

Hence, ‘**416**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

9 × 98 ÷ 14 + 3 − 19 = 11
questions.solution:
1. − and +

Given equation: 9 × 98 ÷ 14 + 3 − 19 = 11

After interchanging the signs, we get:

9 × 98 ÷ 14 - 3 + 19 = 11

⇒ 9 × 7 - 3 + 19 = 11

⇒ 63 - 3 + 19 = 11

⇒ 79 ≠ 11 

2. + and ×

Given equation: 9 × 98 ÷ 14 + 3 − 19 = 11

After interchanging the signs, we get:

9 + 98 ÷ 14 × 3 − 19 = 11

⇒ 9 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 11

⇒ 9 + 21 - 19 = 11

⇒ 30 - 19 = 11

⇒ **11 = 11**

3. − and ×

Given equation: 9 × 98 ÷ 14 + 3 − 19 = 11

After interchanging the signs, we get:

9 - 98 ÷ 14 + 3 × 19 = 11

⇒ 9 - 7 + 57 = 11

⇒ 59 ≠ 11

4. ÷ and –

Given equation: 9 × 98 ÷ 14 + 3 − 19 = 11

After interchanging the signs, we get:

9 × 98 - 14 + 3 ÷ 19 = 11

⇒ 882 - 14 + 0.157 = 11

⇒ 868.157 ≠ 11

Hence, ‘**+ and ×**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: ______ is a tax system that collects a greater share of income from those with high incomes than from those with lower incomes.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Progressive tax.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Progressive Tax

 
 
• In progressive taxation, the tax liability increases with individual or entity income.
 
• This is based on the principle of ability to pay.
 
• Under this system, the lowest income people are generally exempted while the highest income people pay the highest taxes.
 
• Income Tax is thus an example of a progressive tax.
 
• Progressive taxation results in the redistribution of income from rich to poor.
 
• A progressive tax charges a higher tax rate for people who earn a higher income. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Proportional Tax

 
 
• In this system, a flat tax is levied regardless of income or wealth.
 
• One example of corporation tax in India whereby government charges a flat rate of 30% on the income earned by the companies in India.
 
 
 
• Regressive Tax
 
 
• A regressive tax is when the tax rate decreases as the amount subject to taxation increases; the tax rate progresses from high to low.
 
• The lowest amount is subject to higher taxation and this leads to individuals with low income bearing the highest-burden of regressive taxes.
 
• Such tax does not take into account the ability to pay.
 
 
 
• Pay-roll tax:
 
 
• The tax that is withheld, charged, or levied on an employer's payroll is known as payroll tax.
 
• Wages, gross salary, incentives, and any other type of remuneration paid to employees shall be included.
 
• Payroll taxes are taxes that an employer is compelled to pay or withhold on behalf of his or her employees.

questions.question: A and B are two prime numbers such that A > B and their LCM is 209. The value of A² - B is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The LCM of two prime numbers is simply their product.

⇒ A × B = 209

⇒ 209 = 19 × 11

Given A > B, we get A = 19 and B = 11.

⇒ A² − B = 19² − 11 = 361 − 11 = 350

**∴ The correct answer is 350.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A and B are prime numbers with A > B.

LCM(A, B) = 209

**Concept Used:**

The LCM of distinct prime numbers is exactly their product, as they do not share any common factors other than 1.

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM = A × B

⇒ A × B = 209

Factorising 209 into prime numbers:

⇒ 209 = 11 × 19

Since A and B are prime and A > B:

⇒ A = 19

⇒ B = 11

Substituting the values into the required expression A² − B:

⇒ A² − B = 19² − 11

⇒ A² − B = 361 − 11

⇒ A² − B = 350

**∴ The correct answer is 350.**

**__Additional Information__**

LCM of Prime Numbers

The lowest common multiple (LCM) of distinct prime numbers is always their product. LCM(a, b) = a × b.

HCF of Prime Numbers

The highest common factor (HCF) of distinct prime numbers is always 1, as they have no other common divisors.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime if their HCF is 1. All prime numbers are co-prime to each other, and certain pairs of composite numbers can also be co-prime (e.g., 4 and 9).
